reasons: Two checks cover the demo case and the control case with exact values.

terms.meaning: a comparison example where nothing is wrong, used to show the app does not over-report

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test imports
sections.what: Brings in the test tools, the document and verification services, and the presentation helpers.
sections.why: Needed to run the tests. Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: verification presentation data
sections.title: Demo story checks
sections.what: Checks that the demo family shows the area and family discrepancies with their values and sources, and that the control family shows only insufficient evidence.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the demo presentation consistent with the stored results. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Checks depend on the exact demo data, so editing that data changes the expected results.

summary: Tests that the verification results show the expected discrepancies for the demo family and show insufficient evidence for the control case.
purpose: Proves the demo story is correct: the first case shows two discrepancies with sources, and the control case shows no discrepancy.
why: Likely reason: the demo must always tell the same story, so the test guards it. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Runs the verification service for the demo family and checks the area and family results with their values and sources. Then runs the control family and checks there are no potential issues and some insufficient evidence results.
inputs: Demo case identifiers and the bundled demo data.
outputs: Pass or fail for the two checks.
risks: Exact values are fixed to the demo data, so changes to that data break the test on purpose.
debug: If a test fails, check the bundled demo data for the family and the verification rules that produced the result.
